privacyPolicy.title: हिंदी मसौदा: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: हिंदी मसौदा: This Privacy Policy explains what information Toolars collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. Toolars is built local-first: traditional calculators and PDF tools run in your browser and do not upload your input unless an AI or cloud step is explicitly enabled.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Information we collect
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: Account information. When you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account ID, name, and email address as returned by Google. We use these to identify your workspace and sync your saved collections, history, and settings.

हिंदी मसौदा: Content you process. Traditional calculators (BMI, mortgage, loan, retirement, and all VitalCalc tools) process your input entirely in your browser. The values you enter never leave your device. PDF tools marked Local process files in your browser; when an AI summarize or cloud step is enabled, the relevant content is sent to the configured provider only after you grant explicit AI consent.
हिंदी मसौदा: Usage data. We collect aggregated, anonymized analytics about which tools are used and errors encountered, so we can improve reliability. We do not sell or rent this data.

हिंदी मसौदा: Cookies and local storage. We use a minimal set of cookies and local storage entries: a session cookie when you are signed in, an AI consent preference, a cookie consent choice, and your theme/appearance preference. See the Cookies section below.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: How we use your information
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: To provide the tools and features you request, including saving your workspace history and collections to your account.
हिंदी मसौदा: To operate AI steps that you explicitly enable, sending only the content required for that step to the configured AI provider.
हिंदी मसौदा: To maintain the security and integrity of the service, detect abuse, and comply with legal obligations.
हिंदी मसौदा: We do not use your information to train AI models, and we do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: AI consent and data processing
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: Toolars labels every step as Local, Cloud, or AI. Steps marked Local never transmit your data. Steps marked AI or Cloud require your explicit consent before any content is sent to a provider.

हिंदी मसौदा: Your AI consent choice is recorded per workspace. You can review and revoke AI consent at any time from Settings → Privacy & AI. Revoking consent disables AI and cloud steps until you re-enable them.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Cookies
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: Toolars uses the following categories of cookies and local storage:
हिंदी मसौदा: Strictly necessary. The signed session cookie (when signed in) is required for authentication and cannot be disabled.
हिंदी मसौदा: Preferences. Your AI consent choice, cookie consent choice, and appearance preference are stored locally so the site remembers them on your next visit.
हिंदी मसौदा: Analytics. Optional, anonymized analytics run only if you accept them in the cookie consent banner. You can withdraw analytics consent at any time.
हिंदी मसौदा: You can clear preferences and analytics storage at any time using your browser settings or from Settings → Privacy & AI.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Data retention
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: We retain your account information and workspace data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your personal data within 30 days.

हिंदी मसौदा: AI consent and run logs are retained to provide an auditable record of your consent choices, as required for accountability under GDPR Article 7(1). You can export these logs from Settings → Privacy & AI.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Your privacy rights
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights over your personal data:
हिंदी मसौदा: Access. Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
हिंदी मसौदा: Rectification. Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
हिंदी मसौदा: Erasure. Request deletion of your personal data (the 'right to be forgotten').
हिंदी मसौदा: Restriction and objection. Ask us to restrict or stop processing your data.
हिंदी मसौदा: Data portability. Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
हिंदी मसौदा: Withdraw consent. Withdraw your AI, analytics, or cookie consent at any time without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal.

हिंदी मसौदा: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at the address below. We respond within 30 days. If you are in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or California, these rights are guaranteed under the GDPR and CCPA respectively.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: International data transfers
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: When you enable an AI or cloud step, your content may be processed by providers located outside your country of residence, including the United States. We rely on standard contractual clauses and provider data processing agreements to ensure appropriate safeguards for such transfers.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Children's privacy
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: Toolars is not directed at children under 13 (or the equivalent minimum age in your jurisdiction) and we do not knowingly collect personal data from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The 'last updated' date at the top reflects the most recent change. Material changes will be highlighted on the site at least seven days before they take effect.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Contact us
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your data rights, email privacy@toolars.app. Include 'Privacy Request' in the subject line.

termsOfService.title: हिंदी मसौदा: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: हिंदी मसौदा: These Terms of Service govern your use of Toolars. By accessing or using the site, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Use of the service
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: You may use Toolars for lawful personal and commercial purposes. Traditional calculators and PDF tools are free to use during the beta.
हिंदी मसौदा: You are responsible for the content you process and for ensuring you have the rights to use any files you upload for AI or cloud steps.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Acceptable use
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: You agree not to: use the service for any unlawful purpose; upload content that infringes the rights of others; attempt to access, disrupt, or reverse-engineer systems you are not authorized to access; use automated means to scrape or overload the service; or submit malicious files or prompts designed to exploit the AI features.
हिंदी मसौदा: Violations may result in suspension of your account and, where applicable, referral to the relevant authorities.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: AI features and consent
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: AI and cloud steps are optional and require your explicit consent before any content is processed by a third-party provider. You are responsible for reviewing which steps are AI-assisted before enabling them.
हिंदी मसौदा: AI-generated output may be inaccurate. You are responsible for verifying AI results before relying on them. Toolars is not liable for decisions made based on AI output.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Your content
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: You retain ownership of the content you process with Toolars. By using cloud or AI steps, you grant the configured provider a license to process that content solely to provide the step you requested.
हिंदी मसौदा: Traditional calculator and local PDF tool inputs remain on your device and are not licensed to Toolars or any provider.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Accounts
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: You are responsible for safeguarding the account credentials provided by your chosen sign-in method and for all activity under your account. Notify us immediately at security@toolars.app if you suspect unauthorized access.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Fees and beta
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: Traditional tools are free during the beta. AI and cloud steps may consume credits or incur charges when paid plans launch. Material changes to pricing will be announced at least 14 days in advance.

sections.heading: हिंदी मसौदा: Disclaimer of warranties
paragraphs: हिंदी मसौदा: The service is provided 'as is' and 'as available' without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied. Calculator results are provided for informational purposes and are not medical, financial, or legal advice. Always consult a qualified professional for such advice.
